# prepare_lora_kit_ui

**In one sentence:** the desktop app — a pywebview window plus the Python code that lets
its web page talk to the dataset pipeline.

## Why it exists
`plk ui` gives you a point-and-click way to manage projects, run steps and review images
instead of using the terminal. The web page (`static/`) cannot call Python directly, so
this package exposes a "bridge" object, runs the pipeline on a background thread, and
serves image thumbnails.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `bridge.py` | `UiBridge` — every method the JavaScript can call: list/create/edit/delete projects, start/cancel runs, poll status, answer a paused step, settings, caption prompts, HF access checks, hardware detection, open a folder. |
| `runner/` | Runs the pipeline in a background thread for the UI, pauses when a step needs a human and resumes with the answer, and builds the project/image payloads. |
| `media.py` | Makes downscaled WEBP thumbnails on demand (`render_variant`), cached in a bounded LRU keyed by file mtime. |
| `static/` | The browser-side app (HTML/JS/CSS). |
| `e2e/` | Builds a fake project, images and run state in `outputs/_ui_mock` for `plk ui --mock`, so you can jump straight to any step screen. |
| `dev_fixture.py` | Re-exports `e2e` under an older name; only `cli/ui.py` still imports it. |
| `paths.py` | `PACKAGE_ROOT` / `PROJECT_ROOT` for this package. |
| `shutdown_diagnostics.py` | `ShutdownDiagnostics` — writes a shutdown timeline with thread dumps to `outputs/shutdown-diagnostics.log`, to debug slow app exits. |
| `windows_shutdown.py` | `suppress_netfx_process_finalizer` — Windows-only workaround that skips a ~15 s .NET finalizer stall on exit. |
| `nflamously.css` | An alternate design-system stylesheet. **Nothing references it** (also noted in `docs/complexity-technical-debt.md`). |

## How it works
- `prepare_lora_kit/cli/ui.py` creates a `UiBridge`, opens a pywebview window on
  `static/index.html`, and mounts a small media server that uses `media.py`.
- The page calls bridge methods (`start_run`, `get_job_status`, …); `bridge.py` delegates
  to `runner/` and to `prepare_lora_kit.project` for project storage.
- When a step needs a decision, `runner/` parks the request; the page shows a modal and
  sends the answer back with `submit_interaction`.
- On exit, `cli/ui.py` uses `shutdown_diagnostics.py` and (on Windows)
  `windows_shutdown.py` to close cleanly and quickly.

## Who uses it
- `prepare_lora_kit/cli/ui.py` — the only production entry point.
- Tests: `tests/ui/` (bridge, runner, media, shutdown) and `tests/ui/static/` (JS).

## Good to know
- Projects are stored under `~/.prepare_lora_kit/projects/`, not in this package.
- Change `bridge.py` → update the JSDoc in `static/core/api.js` too (see `AGENTS.md`).
